svg.aria-label: A two-by-two grid of how much rests on a decision against what it is worth if it is right. Little rests on it, worth little: regenerate it freely. Little rests on it, worth a lot: build early and iterate, ordered by urgency and capacity with cost of delay deciding which goes first, for example a new screen for a high-demand journey. Much rests on it, worth little: load-bearing by accident, put it behind an interface before more is built on it, for example a reference format from the first integration. Much rests on it, worth a lot: strategic commitments, where building early and deciding carefully collide, so buy information, stage the commitment, or reduce the weight, for example a ledger model or Stripe's developer-first core. A judgement aid, not a scoring model: the axes are often correlated, and the grid separates them for analysis.
svg.text: What to do with a decision, by weight and value
